title: Hugo Prince
author: Hugo Prince
description: This podcast (audio, motivational clips and shows) was created to leave a legacy for my future generations. For those that want to follow me, I hope you could learn a thing or two. Hugo Prince is a social media entrepreneur and podcaster from Montreal, Canada. The first entrepreneurial project he wanted to do was a mobile payment application. He was always fascinated by technology more accurately by the change that it brings to society.
